local platform = workspace:WaitForChild("Platform")
local startCF = platform.CFrame
local offset = Vector3.new(8, 0, 0)
local duration = 3

local function tweenTo(targetCF)
	local conn
	local start = startCF
	local t = 0
	conn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		t += dt
		local alpha = math.clamp(t / duration, 0, 1)
		platform.CFrame = start:Lerp(targetCF, alpha)
		if alpha >= 1 then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		tweenTo(startCF + offset)
		task.wait(duration)
		tweenTo(startCF)
		task.wait(duration)
	end
end)

-- ServerScriptService/BuyItemServer.lua

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ITEMS = {
	Sword = {
		Price = 100,
		ToolId = nil, -- set to a tool asset id, or clone from ServerStorage
	},
}

local buyItemEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyItem")
if not buyItemEvent then
	buyItemEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyItemEvent.Name = "BuyItem"
	buyItemEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local swordTemplate = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Sword")

local function giveSword(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not backpack then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if character and character:FindFirstChild("Sword") then
		return -- already holding one
	end
	if backpack:FindFirstChild("Sword") then
		return -- already owns one
	end

	local tool: Tool
	if swordTemplate then
		tool = swordTemplate:Clone()
	else
		tool = Instance.new("Tool")
		tool.Name = "Sword"
		tool.RequiresHandle = true

		local handle = Instance.new("Part")
		handle.Name = "Handle"
		handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 4, 0.4)
		handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
		handle.Parent = tool
	end

	tool.Parent = backpack
end

buyItemEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, itemName: unknown)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	if coins.Value < item.Price then
		return -- not enough coins; server never trusts the client
	end

	coins.Value -= item.Price

	if itemName == "Sword" then
		giveSword(player)
	end
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local POTION_COST = 25
local MAX_QUANTITY = 100

local buyPotionEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
buyPotionEvent.Name = "BuyPotion"
buyPotionEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getLeaderstat(player: Player, name: string): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) :: IntValue?
end

buyPotionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, quantity: unknown)
	if typeof(quantity) ~= "number" then
		return
	end

	quantity = math.floor(quantity)
	if quantity < 1 or quantity > MAX_QUANTITY then
		return
	end

	local coins = getLeaderstat(player, "Coins")
	local potions = getLeaderstat(player, "Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then
		return
	end

	local totalCost = quantity * POTION_COST
	if coins.Value < totalCost then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= totalCost
	potions.Value += quantity
end)

-- ServerScriptService/PetRenameServer.lua

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create the RemoteEvent
local renamePetEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RenamePet")
if not renamePetEvent then
	renamePetEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	renamePetEvent.Name = "RenamePet"
	renamePetEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 24

local function sanitizeName(rawName: string): string
	local cleaned = rawName:gsub("[%c%s]+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if #cleaned > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		cleaned = cleaned:sub(1, MAX_NAME_LENGTH)
	end
	return cleaned
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	-- Create the PetName StringValue
	local petName = Instance.new("StringValue")
	petName.Name = "PetName"
	petName.Value = "Pet"
	petName.Parent = player

	renamePetEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(firingPlayer: Player, newName: unknown)
		-- Never trust the client: verify identity and validate the payload
		if firingPlayer ~= player then
			return
		end
		if typeof(newName) ~= "string" then
			return
		end

		local cleaned = sanitizeName(newName)
		if #cleaned == 0 then
			return
		end

		petName.Value = cleaned
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local PlayerData = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local CoinManager = {}

function CoinManager.addCoins(userId: number, amount: number): number
	local key = "Player_" .. userId

	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return PlayerData:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	local currentCoins = 0
	if success and type(data) == "table" and type(data.Coins) == "number" then
		currentCoins = data.Coins
	elseif success and type(data) == "number" then
		currentCoins = data
	end

	local newTotal = currentCoins + amount

	local saveSuccess = pcall(function()
		PlayerData:SetAsync(key, { Coins = newTotal })
	end)

	if not saveSuccess then
		error(("Failed to save coins for player %d"):format(userId))
	end

	return newTotal
end

return CoinManager

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local sessionData = {} -- [player] = coins value
local saving = false

local function getCoinsValue(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
end

local function loadData(player)
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn(("Failed to load data for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, tostring(result)))
		-- Retry once before kicking, so nobody loses progress
		task.wait(2)
		success, result = pcall(function()
			return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
		end)
		if not success then
			player:Kick("Your data failed to load. Please rejoin to avoid losing progress.")
			return
		end
	end

	local coins = (typeof(result) == "number") and result or 0

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"

	local coinsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coinsValue.Name = "Coins"
	coinsValue.Value = coins
	coinsValue.Parent = leaderstats

	leaderstats.Parent = player

	sessionData[player] = coinsValue
end

local function saveData(player)
	local coinsValue = sessionData[player]
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end

	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local coins = coinsValue.Value

	local success, err = pcall(function()
		dataStore:SetAsync(key, coins)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn(("Failed to save data for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, tostring(err)))
		return false
	end

	return true
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(loadData)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local ok = saveData(player)
	if not ok then
		-- Last-ditch retry so nobody loses progress
		task.wait(2)
		saveData(player)
	end
	sessionData[player] = nil
end)

-- Autosave every 60 seconds
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		for player in sessionData do
			task.spawn(saveData, player)
		end
	end
end)

-- Save everyone on shutdown
game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		task.wait(1)
	end

	saving = true
	local remaining = {}

	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local done = false
		task.spawn(function()
			saveData(player)
			done = true
		end)
		remaining[player] = function() return done end
	end

	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		local allDone = true
		for _, isDone in remaining do
			if not isDone() then
				allDone = false
				break
			end
		end
		if allDone then
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end

	saving = false
end)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local success, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if success and typeof(saved) == "number" then
		coins.Value = math.floor(saved)
	elseif not success then
		warn(("Failed to load data for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, saved))
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then
		return
	end

	local value = coins.Value
	local tries = 0
	local success, err

	repeat
		tries += 1
		success, err = pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, value)
		end)
		if not success then
			task.wait(2)
		end
	until success or tries >= 3

	if not success then
		warn(("Failed to save data for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, err))
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		onPlayerRemoving(player)
	end
end)
